places: note - the US Embassy is in Abidjan

fields.climate: tropical along coast, semiarid in far north; three seasons - warm and dry (November to March), hot and dry (March to May), hot and wet (June to October)
fields.terrain: mostly flat to undulating plains; mountains in northwest
fields.hazards: coast has heavy surf and no natural harbors; during the rainy season torrential flooding is possible
fields.resources: petroleum, natural gas, diamonds, manganese, iron ore, cobalt, bauxite, copper, gold, nickel, tantalum, silica sand, clay, cocoa beans, coffee, palm oil, hydropower
fields.farm: yams, cassava, oil palm fruit, cocoa beans, sugarcane, plantains, rice, rubber, maize, cashews
fields.exports: gold, cocoa beans, rubber, refined petroleum, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews
fields.industries: foodstuffs, beverages; wood products, oil refining, gold mining, truck and bus assembly, textiles, fertilizer, building materials, electricity
fields.languages: French (official), 60 native dialects of which Dioula is the most widely spoken
fields.religions: Muslim 42.9%, Catholic 17.2%, Evangelical 11.8%, Methodist 1.7%, other Christian 3.2%, animist 3.6%, other religion 0.5%, none 19.1%
fields.legal: civil law system based on the French civil code; Constitutional Chamber of the Supreme Court reviews legislation
fields.military: 18-26 (up to 35 for healthcare professionals) years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; conscription is authorized but reportedly not enforced
